construction: Two equal label groups: independent N(0,0.02^2) features, class 1 shifted by 10 in coordinate 0. Ring edges or a star centred at node 0. Control arrival: label 0, coordinate 0=30, all others zero. Enemy arrival: label 1 at origin. Attach to node 1 except star_hub, which attaches to node 0. Oracle labels, fixed features; no normalization (controlled Euclidean geometry).
design: One insertion from a fresh identical initial state per repetition; paired graph/features across scenarios within size and seed. Five seeds, five timing repetitions, one warmup per case. Not a long stream or a node classification benchmark.
timing: perf_counter_ns; alternate incremental/batch order per repetition. Incremental includes feature/label append, radius update, CSR extension, touch set, rough-weight kernel and writes to maintained dictionary. Batch includes same input/CSR extension, vectorized Gram radius rebuild, edge-list weight rebuild and dictionary materialization. Cloning initial maintained state and initial batch construction excluded. Correctness excluded from timing. CPU thread limits set to one before NumPy import.
checks: Direct-difference batch radius reference; scalar loop rough-weight reference over every edge; finite/infinite pattern, full maintained support including zero weights, symmetry, no nonedges and tolerance 1e-9. Assert expected shrink/touch/total-degree counts. Fail and preserve partial raw data on any mismatch.
aggregation: Median latency per seed across five repeats, mean and population SD across five seed medians; speedup per seed = median batch total / median incremental total, then mean and population SD. Timing repeats are not independent seeds. No significance test, no excluded cases or wins-only reporting.
memory: Suite process peak RSS (includes initialization and correctness references), not per-insertion peak; input state payload bytes recorded separately, excluding Python object overhead.
interpretation: Test correctness in adverse locality regimes; assess Q_T versus touch-set size and global shrink. No guaranteed speedup. Report slowdowns and all cases. Sizes fixed before observation, no extrapolated exponent.
